lines.text: The Philistines searched for David after he was anointed king, so he went down to the stronghold.
David asked the LORD whether to go up against the Philistines, and the LORD told him to go up.
David defeated the Philistines at Baal-perazim, and he and his men carried away their abandoned idols.
When the Philistines returned to the Valley of Rephaim, the LORD told David to circle behind them and attack in front of the cedar trees.
David did as the LORD commanded and struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Hebron.
